``` ::: ::: ## How to use it - **Manhattan (interactive)** — Manhattan plot of the whole genome, hover through a locus to show colocalization details. - **Colocalization Explorer** — Full colocalization bubble plot, you can filter by dataset family and locus. - **Development vs Adult** — Dev/adult contrast, with highlight to dev-only pairs. - **Cell Type Specificity** — cell type specificity heatmap (sceQTL). - **Locus Table** — browsable table, with an overview of results by locus. ## A peek at the methodology The results shown correspond to Bayesian colocalization (`coloc.abf`, PP.H4 ≥ 0,8) between the consensus AD GWAS (2026) and 23 xQTL datasets — BigBrain (adult, eQTL/sQTL), DevBrain (fetal, eQTL/sQTL), SingleBrain (7 major cell types) e GTEx (15 tissues). Colocalization windows were defined as 500 kb centered at the reported lead variant of each locus. Full methods will be published soon in a paper. Pipeline: [`nf_coloc`](https://github.com/juliaapolonio/nf_coloc).
